sentences.en: No one has the right to expel Dan from this country.
sentences.zh: 没有人有权把丹从这个国家开除出去。

sentences.en: The elders decided to expel him from the village.
sentences.zh: 长老们决定把他驱逐出村庄。

sentences.en: The Ottomans were finally able to expel the Spanish and capture Algiers.
sentences.zh: 奥斯曼人终于能够把西班牙人赶走并占领了阿尔及尔。

senses.zh: 驱逐,赶走,把…除名,排出（气体等）
